d: The Account Manager – Enterprise is responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of Enterprise clients by delivering ZainTECH’s ICT and digital solutions portfolio. The role focuses on building strong customer relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and driving revenue through consultative selling across cloud, cybersecurity, data, and digital solutions.

Working closely with internal sales, technical, and delivery teams, the Account Manager ensures customer satisfaction while expanding account value through upselling, cross-selling, and new business development within assigned accounts.
q: 3-5 years of experience in account management, sales, or business development within ICT or technology sectors
Experience managing Enterprise or enterprise customer accounts
Good understanding of ICT solutions including Cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Cybersecurity, Data and analytics, and Digital transformation solutions
Proven ability to drive account growth through upselling and cross-selling
Experience working with major ICT and cloud platforms such as Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or similar.
Knowledge of cybersecurity, data management, networking, and digital transformation best practices.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
r: Manage a portfolio of Enterprise accounts, acting as the primary point of contact for customer engagement
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their business and technology needs
Conduct regular account reviews to assess performance, identify opportunities, and ensure customer satisfaction
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure seamless delivery of services and solutions
Manage contract renewals and ensure continued value realization for customers
Develop a strong understanding of ZainTECH’s portfolio across cloud, cybersecurity, data, and digital solutions
Work with clients to align technology solutions with their business objectives and operational needs
Collaborate with technical and presales teams to position integrated solutions across multiple service areas
Identify and pursue opportunities to expand services within existing accounts
Support pipeline development through upselling and cross-selling initiatives
Contribute to account planning and growth strategies for assigned clients
Prepare and deliver proposals and presentations aligned with customer requirements and business outcomes
Participate in client meetings, events, and engagements to strengthen relationships and generate opportunities
Work closely with product, presales, and delivery teams to ensure successful solution positioning and execution
Engage with both technical and business stakeholders to ensure alignment of solutions with client needs
Manage and resolve customer issues in coordination with internal teams to maintain high levels of satisfaction
Maintain accurate records of account activities and opportunities within CRM systems
x: At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. We are looking for individuals who share these values and are committed to customer-centricity and ethical excellence. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from how we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally.

d: We are currently looking for a dynamic, passionate, and self-motivated Food & Beverage professional who is ready to take the next step in their hospitality career.

As a Head Bartender, you will be responsible for delivering an exceptional beverage experience while leading by example and maintaining the highest standards of service, quality, and hospitality. With your creativity, beverage knowledge, and engaging personality, you will create memorable guest experiences while supporting the team in maximizing guest satisfaction and revenue.
q: You should ideally have a diploma in Hospitality Management or relevant vocational training in Food & Beverage, with a minimum of two years of experience in bar operations, preferably within a hotel, high-volume restaurant, or upscale bar environment.

An excellent command of English is essential, together with strong guest service, communication, and interpersonal skills. You should have sound knowledge of wines, spirits, liquors, cocktails, and beverage preparation techniques, along with confident bartending and presentation skills.
Previous experience in a team-leading or supervisory capacity will be a definite advantage, particularly in coaching team members and supporting smooth daily bar operations.
The ideal candidate will be a well-presented, confident, and engaging hospitality professional with a genuine passion for beverages, people, and exceptional service.

You should be hands-on, proactive, charismatic, and approachable, with the ability to create positive connections with both guests and colleagues. You will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, remain calm and professional under pressure, and thrive as part of a multicultural team.
You should possess the following key competencies
r: Deliver professional and personalized beverage service in accordance with the hotel’s established standards.
Lead by example and ensure the bar team consistently provides warm, efficient, and engaging service .
Prepare and serve a wide range of beverages and cocktails while maintaining consistency in quality, presentation, and taste .
Conduct regular training and coaching sessions for the bar team, including beverage knowledge, cocktail preparation, pouring techniques, presentation, and upselling .
Ensure the timely setup of all bar areas and completion of mise en place prior to opening and throughout operations.
Introduce and recommend creative, innovative, and trend-led beverage offerings that enhance the guest experience.
Actively promote beverages and apply effective upselling techniques to maximize sales and revenue opportunities.
Monitor the efficient use of products and resources while minimizing wastage, breakage, and unnecessary costs.
Prepare and process store and bar requisitions , ensuring adequate stock levels for daily operations.
Monitor the quality, availability, and presentation of beverages and bar supplies.
Handle guest feedback and complaints promptly and professionally, escalating matters to the appropriate manager when required.
Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, organization, and food safety throughout the bar and service areas.
Build positive relationships with guests and colleagues through a courteous, professional, and approachable manner .
Support smooth daily bar operations, particularly during peak periods, and work closely with the wider Food & Beverage team.
Contribute to creating memorable experiences and delivering “Treasured Time” for every guest.

d: ACS Group is looking for an experienced Head of Property Management to lead and oversee an international portfolio of luxury residential properties across the UK, Europe, and the Middle East.
The portfolio includes a primary residence in London, seasonal residences in Cyprus, the UAE, and the Alps, as well as occasional involvement with properties in France, Switzerland, and Italy.

This is a senior leadership position focused on the strategic and operational oversight of multiple luxury residences. The successful candidate will lead an established household team, coordinate external contractors and professional advisors, oversee property-related projects, and ensure that all residences operate to the highest standards.

This role is particularly suited to a commercially minded professional who combines strong leadership capabilities, luxury hospitality experience, and extensive knowledge of residential property management.
q: Minimum 5 years of experience in luxury residential property management, preferably in a senior management or leadership position.
Strong knowledge of the London luxury residential property market.
Established professional network of premium contractors, suppliers, service providers, and real estate professionals.
Proven experience overseeing household teams or luxury hospitality operations.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple properties or complex residential operations.
Strong project management background, including renovations, refurbishment, and contractor management.
Experience with financial planning, budgeting, cost control, and reporting.
Excellent understanding of property regulations, compliance, and operational best practices.
Outstanding leadership, organisational, negotiation, and communication skills.
Currently based in London or willing to relocate.
Willingness and ability to travel internationally, particularly to the UAE, Cyprus, and other European destinations.
r: Oversee the overall management and operational performance of an international portfolio of luxury residential properties.
Establish and maintain exceptional operational and presentation standards across all residences.
Conduct regular property inspections to assess condition, maintenance requirements, compliance, and operational efficiency.
Coordinate the preparation of international residences ahead of the family's arrival.
Ensure properties are maintained efficiently and cost-effectively.
Develop and implement procedures to improve property operations and service standards.
Provide leadership and strategic direction to an established household team, including butlers, chefs, housekeepers, gardeners, and maintenance personnel.
Oversee team structure, staff rotations, and workforce planning in line with operational requirements.
Lead recruitment, onboarding, training, and professional development of household employees.
Ensure effective communication and coordination between household teams across different locations.
Work closely with security personnel and other support functions.
Assess the condition of properties and establish priorities for maintenance, repairs, and improvements.
Oversee renovation, refurbishment, and property improvement projects.
Identify, evaluate, and appoint reliable contractors, suppliers, and external specialists.
Manage tenders, negotiate commercial terms, and ensure value for money.
Monitor project budgets, timelines, quality, and overall delivery.
Oversee ongoing projects, including a partial renovation of the primary London residence.
Oversee property budgets, operating expenses, and financial planning across the portfolio.
Ensure effective cost control and responsible allocation of resources.
Manage property lease agreements and coordinate with legal, financial, tax, and insurance advisors.
Evaluate potential new properties in collaboration with professional real estate brokers.
Provide regular updates and reports on property operations, expenditure, and ongoing projects.
x: London-based position with responsibility for an international property portfolio.
Monday–Friday working schedule, with weekends off as standard.
Flexible, self-managed working hours and a high degree of autonomy.
All business travel expenses outside the UK covered, including accommodation, per diem, local transportation, visas, communications, and insurance.
Dedicated administrative and operational support, including assistance with procurement, documentation, payments, and staff travel arrangements.
An established household team and access to professional external contractors and advisors.
Competitive compensation package, with a salary review following the initial period.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced property management professional to take on a senior leadership role overseeing a prestigious international residential portfolio.
You will have the autonomy to shape property operations, lead established teams, oversee significant projects, and implement long-term operational strategies across multiple international residences.
If you have the relevant experience and are interested in this opportunity, we would be pleased to hear from you.
